target_customer: Small and medium retailers and local service businesses in India (cafes, salons, gyms, bakeries, dry cleaners, florists)
problem: Indian local retailers lack an easy way to turn customers into repeat buyers; JoinSub let them sell subscription programs to drive repurchases.
business_model: Aggregator and SaaS for local business subscription programs (take rate or fee not found)

founders.name: Dhruv Goel
previous_startups: Repeat founder; currently building a group buying app for digital consumer goods (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: engineer by training.

founders.name: Ankur Solanki
education: NSIT, Delhi University, B.Tech (as written on YC page)
previous_startups: Co-founded a healthcare startup during his MBA

competitors.name: Fleek
competitors.what: Subscription management platform for Indian businesses
competitors.traction_then: not stated in the source I could open
competitors.funding_then: Raised $1M seed led by Axilor, reported September 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: A merchant dashboard and consumer subscription flow with payments is ordinary web and mobile engineering; the hard part was merchant onboarding, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: No data or network effect was described; any local commerce app or payment provider could add a subscription feature and merchants could easily leave.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows what incumbents did against JoinSub specifically.

market_need_then: YC description cites over 14 million retail outlets in India and the aim of driving repeat purchases; no independent evidence of merchant demand was found.

brand_strength.rationale: A brand search returned only unrelated Join-named companies; no press or community about the JoinSub brand was found.

outcome_analysis: JoinSub was a Winter 2021 YC company aiming to sell subscription programs for Indian local retailers. The YC page marks it inactive and notes the same founders started Splitsub, a subscription sharing product, but no shutdown notice, date or stated cause was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factor is assigned. Funding rests on a single tracker reporting a roughly $125K seed in June 2021.
notes: joinsub.com returned HTTP 503 so the site status is unknown. The $125K seed rests on a single database (VCBacked, repeated by TheCompanyCheck) and is probably the YC standard deal. Trackers disagree on founding year (YC says 2021, one says 2019). The Fleek source is dated about six months after the batch, so it is a weak competitor entry. Founders Dhruv Goel and Ankur Solanki appear on the YC page; trackers name the same pair. Splitsub is a sister product by the same team, not a recorded pivot.
